newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on fund, commission buying.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on fund, commission buying.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on fund spreading and commission house short covering, traders said.

"Commission houses covered shorts and the funds bought 316 Mar-May at $2.20," a trader said. May-Nov spread at $37.50, Jan-Mar $1.90, Jan-May $5. January futures crush margin rose to -34.45 from Thursday close at -34.97.

January canola rose $2.70 a tonne to $406.30 and March closed up $1.70 at $408.20. Volume was 2,738 lots, 75 hedges. January flax lost $2.30 to $368 on commercial sales. The Gunay A began loading flax in Thunder Bay Sunday bound for a foreign port.
February western barley fell $0.50 to close at $142.80 on hedges, commercial selling and spillover pressure from CBOT corn. Nov Feb spread at $1.50, Feb-July $0.50. Volume was 700 lots.
December wheat futures rose $0.50 to $169.10 on commercial and commission short covering, March rose $0.60 to $169.70. Dec-Mar spread at $0.50. Volume was 455 lots.
March oats fell US$1 to US$118 and July lost US$4 to US$115. Volume was 15 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas, oats).
